function f(this: { x: number }) { return this.x; }
const o = { x: 1, f };
console.log(o["f"](), o.f(), (o["f"])());
const k = "f";
console.log(o[k]());
const p: { x: number; f: typeof f } | undefined = o as { x: number; f: typeof f } | undefined;
console.log(p?.["f"](), p?.f());
const bad = { y: 1, f };
console.log(bad["f"]());
const g = o.f;
console.log(g());
